posts.title: New game coming soon!
posts.text: A new game is coming to the Firefly Launcher today!

posts.title: Two new games: Seedling and Rock to Riches
posts.text:
Two new games have joined the Firefly Launcher!

Seedling is a little garden that grows in real time. Plant strawberries, radishes and cherry trees from single seeds, and look after them through real seasons, weather and garden chores.

Rock to Riches is a factory game about turning plain rocks into a fortune. Drop rocks on a belt, run them through machines to raise their value, sell them, and spend the money on bigger and better things.

Both are in your game list now, ready to install. Have fun!
